campaign.title: Full-proof frontier and current-primary-literature reassessment

resource_policy.literature_policy: Mandatory current-primary-literature review as of 2026-08-26. Use official journal, author, or arXiv sources; audit exact theorem hypotheses and do not promote a structural analogy.

frozen_target.question: Given the authoritative graph after Round 165, what is the highest-leverage exact next inequality for a full proof, after comparing both residual Fejer scales, direct residual and remaining hard-TOP channels, BAL, UNBAL, both direct M1 parents, the GAR alternative, endpoint assembly, and current primary literature?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Compare the minimal residual aggregate (165.K17a), the maximal even medium/long aggregate (165.K26), every other mandatory M1/M2 parent and the alternative GAR bridge. Produce an exact dependency/power/applicability matrix and select precisely one Round-167 analytic objective. No open estimate or source analogy is promoted.
quantities: The standard quarter route requires both direct M1 parents, all three M2 parents, endpoint uniformity, M9, and the accepted bridge.
The alternative route requires the complete GAR theorem and all of M9-M2; it does not prove blockwise M9-M1.
Round 165 proves parity, monotone tangent, high-gcd, dual-gcd, phase-ledger, and variable-scale reductions only.
At minimal scale the open target is (165.K17a) of size L^2X^epsilon; at maximal scale it is (165.K26) of size L^3X^epsilon.
Either residual theorem leaves other few-point hard-TOP channels and near collars before a hard-TOP parent can close.
The internally proved exponent is 1/3; the audited external Li-Yang benchmark is 0.3144831759740614...; the target is 1/4.
A literature match must preserve quantifiers, coefficient class, absolute-value placement, parameter ranges, levels, support, endpoints, and completion costs.

completion_criteria: Reconstruct the exact standard and alternative full-proof dependency trees from the authoritative graph, including every open mandatory leaf and logical OR.

Compare (165.K17a), (165.K26), direct residual scalar, remaining hard-TOP channels, BAL, UNBAL, both direct M1 parents, GAR, endpoint uniformity, and any lawful sub-one-third route with exact target and capacity ledgers.
For each candidate, name the first genuinely new noninvertible or sign-sensitive mechanism needed and every already accepted obstruction it must bypass.
Search current primary literature and record exact theorem numbers, hypotheses, quantifiers, absolute-value placement, parameter maps, boundary/completion costs, and first failed hypothesis.
Check whether any current primary source changes the certified external exponent or directly proves an exact project interface; otherwise record a dated scoped no-match.
Select exactly one Round-167 analytic objective, its promotion gate, false controls, stop rule, and downstream scope.
Produce a conductor full-proof strategy synthesis without changing proof statuses unless a separately validated proof or source audit licenses it.
Close under exactly one label: strategy_frontier_retained, strategy_frontier_reselected, or strategy_source_update_only.

review_seams.requirement: Verify the complete graph tree, logical ORs, and that no local result is advertised as a parent or global theorem.
Verify every target size, positive capacity, missing saving, owner scope, and exponent connector.
Verify primary-source dates, theorem statements, quantifiers, coefficients, ranges, endpoint costs, and current benchmark.
Verify exactly one frozen next inequality with new mechanism, controls, stop rule, and no proof-state overpromotion.

closing_assessment.main_result: The standard and GAR proof trees, every requested frontier, and current primary sources were audited. The minimal residual aggregate (165.K17a) is retained as the sole Round-167 inequality through one determinant-equation source-to-literal-interface/no-go gate. No source proves it, every parent remains open, and both global exponents are unchanged.
